rationale: The only Meta audience that actually matches the ICP. Meta cannot target 'Danish accounting firms with 10+ staff' by interest - that targeting does not exist. outreach-engine already produces the exact list, so upload it hashed and let Meta be account-based air cover over outreach rather than a prospecting channel.
notes: Above Meta's 1,000 floor only when both countries and all three verticals are combined. A single-vertical slice will under-deliver.
decision: 2026-09-17, founder: ONE combined ad set on the English page. Splitting this list into DK and LT ad sets is the single-vertical slice the note above warns about, so delivery was chosen over localisation. Rejected alternative: two ad sets at /da and /lt under dk-outreach-list and lt-outreach-list. Consequence: this is the one audience that cannot use the Danish and Lithuanian pages, so language stays a live explanation for a flat result here and the ad set cannot test it. See docs/FUNNEL-HANDOFF.md.
blocked_on: THE LIST DOES NOT EXIST. outreach-engine can gate and export a list but cannot produce one: segments/ holds three example rows with fake domains, queue/*.csv is gitignored, and the Lithuanian registry fetchers are deliberately unimplemented. Priority 1 and not actionable. Recovered 2026-09-18 from the retired confident-ritchie handoff; see docs/FUNNEL-HANDOFF.md.
frequency: OUTCOME_TRAFFIC has no frequency cap - that is a Reach-objective feature, dropped when the live campaign switched to Traffic. Correct for broad geo, wrong here: at ~2,000 people saturation is days away. This ad set likely needs its own campaign rather than a slot in the existing one.
